context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 testing completed successfully. Dynamic Form Engine features verified: 1) Form Tab Builder at /dashboard/form-tabs allows admin to create/edit/delete/reorder custom tabs. 2) Tabs have fields with types: text, number, textarea, select, checkbox, date. 3) Tabs can be toggled active/inactive - inactive tabs don't appear in SiteVisitForm. 4) Dynamic tabs appear in SiteVisitForm between Materials (step 4) and Site Docs (final step). 5) Custom field data stored in project.custom_fields[tab_slug][field_name]. 6) Existing tabs: Subsidy Details (3 fields, all roles), Finance Details (4 fields, admin+manager), Customer Preferences (3 fields, admin+staff). 7) Smart Suggestions in Materials step calculates system size based on monthly consumption. 8) Roof area auto-calculates from length x width. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_form_tabs.py covers all API endpoints.
